mapper.select: SELECT G.LABEL , G.CNT , ROUND(G.CNT * 100 / T.TOTAL, 1) AS PCT , G.EXTRA FROM ( SELECT MAX(S.SKILL_NAME) AS LABEL , COUNT(*) AS CNT , ROUND(AVG(P.APPLY_COUNT), 1) AS EXTRA FROM TB_PROJECT_SKILL PS JOIN TB_SKILL S ON S.SKILL_ID = PS.SKILL_ID JOIN TB_PROJECT P ON P.PROJ_IDX = PS.PROJ_IDX GROUP BY S.SKILL_KEY ) G CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM TB_PROJECT) T ORDER BY G.CNT DESC, G.LABEL FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NVL(REGION, '미지정') AS LABEL , COUNT(*) AS CNT , ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 1) AS PCT FROM TB_PROJECT GROUP BY NVL(REGION, '미지정') ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT BUCKET AS LABEL , COUNT(*) AS CNT , ROUND(RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () * 100, 1) AS PCT FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COST_MAX IS NULL THEN '협의' WHEN COST_MAX < 300 THEN '300만 미만' WHEN COST_MAX < 1000 THEN '300~1,000만' WHEN COST_MAX < 3000 THEN '1,000~3,000만' ELSE '3,000만 이상' END AS BUCKET , CASE WHEN COST_MAX IS NULL THEN 9 WHEN COST_MAX < 300 THEN 1 WHEN COST_MAX < 1000 THEN 2 WHEN COST_MAX < 3000 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS SORT_NO FROM TB_PROJECT ) GROUP BY BUCKET, SORT_NO ORDER BY SORT_NO

SELECT LABEL , CNT , SUM(CNT) OVER (ORDER BY LABEL) AS EXTRA FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(POSTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') AS LABEL , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_PROJECT WHERE POSTED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -(#{months} - 1)) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(POSTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') ) ORDER BY LABEL
